compilationRule: FAIL when any critical check reports a problem; the compiler then exits 3

checks.title: Every original requirement and obligation is represented verbatim; the baseline matches its source commit
Every normalized requirement and obligation traces to its source
No unresolved contradiction is silently accepted
All referenced dependencies, tasks, decisions and contracts exist
The dependency graph is a valid DAG with justified edges
Every contract is identifiable and no contract is over-claimed
Every fixed decision has a verified authoritative source and constraints
Both execution plans preserve the complete scope, dependencies and completion conditions
No requirement is marked complete; the source commit holds no application implementation
Every citation is found verbatim at the recorded commit
Every repository checkout is at the recorded commit
The Percepta experiment references defined metrics and generated plans
Every readiness blocker is classified and every open decision carries alternatives, a recommendation and the approval it needs
Preflight and timed-execution manifests are complete and consistent
Every P0 requirement is covered by a work item and a verification gate
The committed baseline has no drift against the source commit (readiness, non-critical for compilation)

The verification plan preserves every baseline P0 requirement and obligation; exclusions are operator-authorized; test bindings resolve and declare valid evidence categories; every obligation carries its derived acceptance contract

rehearsalReadiness.rule: BLOCKED while any critical material unresolved finding, unresolved decision, blocked contract, or missing contract that no planned task produces remains; a compilation PASS is not readiness
